# Command reference (`fa`)

Every command of the `fa` tool. `fa <command> --help` shows the same. Commands that change files accept `--dry-run` (show the changes, write nothing); `--json` prints machine-readable results (what AI agents read through `fa mcp`). Exit codes: 0 success, 1 a build or check failed, 2 usage or configuration error.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`fa audit-print`](#fa-audit-print) | printed font/line sizes of figures on a page preset |
| [`fa baseline`](#fa-baseline) | record/check compendium output hashes (check\|record [--build]) |
| [`fa build`](#fa-build) | analysis -> publish -> verify for projects |
| [`fa bundle`](#fa-bundle) | data bundles: check them against their contract, or list the contracts |
| [`fa claims`](#fa-claims) | numbers typed by hand into figure legends (they go stale when data changes) |
| [`fa diff-figure`](#fa-diff-figure) | what changed in a figure since a storyline snapshot or a saved record |
| [`fa export`](#fa-export) | package a published figure as an RO-Crate (files, source data, provenance) |
| [`fa impact`](#fa-impact) | which published figures used a given file or folder |
| [`fa ingest`](#fa-ingest) | add a data bundle to a project: check it, write its full plots block, build |
| [`fa init`](#fa-init) | make a project repository here (or in PATH): folders, marker, rules, .gitignore |
| [`fa inventory`](#fa-inventory) | regenerate (or --check) docs/reference/renderer_inventory.md |
| [`fa lineage`](#fa-lineage) | a published figure's upstream: outputs <- run <- config <- code <- data |
| [`fa lint`](#fa-lint) | config keys the build never read, likely typos, and defaults used |
| [`fa list`](#fa-list) | list projects |
| [`fa manifest`](#fa-manifest) | consolidate outputs/clean_atlas_manifest.csv |
| [`fa mcp`](#fa-mcp) | serve the fa commands as tools to AI agents (Model Context Protocol, stdio) |
| [`fa new`](#fa-new) | create a project (config, analysis script, figure spec, build-list entry) or a renderer (module with its SCHEMA, test, export) |
| [`fa omics`](#fa-omics) | omics pack: list its modules, renderers, contracts and plot types |
| [`fa param`](#fa-param) | renderer parameters: scaffold \| explain \| sync |
| [`fa preflight`](#fa-preflight) | overlap, clipping and panel-intrusion checks (--projects ...) |
| [`fa promote`](#fa-promote) | promote an exploratory project to a paper figure (AGENTS.md 5.2) |
| [`fa reference`](#fa-reference) | regenerate (or --check) docs/reference/{cli,config,gallery}.md |
| [`fa renderers`](#fa-renderers) | plot names fig_atlas.render() can draw: core, packs and recipes |
| [`fa retire`](#fa-retire) | move a project to <domain>/archive/ (AGENTS.md 5.3) and build it once |
| [`fa status`](#fa-status) | which published figures are stale (inputs/code/config changed) |
| [`fa storyline`](#fa-storyline) | storyline tools: new \| compile [--plan\|--all] \| init \| registry \| check \| revisions \| snapshots \| diff \| requests \| evidence |
| [`fa verify`](#fa-verify) | completeness checks for one built project |

## fa audit-print

printed font/line sizes of figures on a page preset

Runs `fig_atlas.tools.audit_print_size`; its own options: `fa audit-print --help`.

## fa baseline

record/check compendium output hashes (check|record [--build])

Runs `fig_atlas.tools.figure_baseline`; its own options: `fa baseline --help`.

## fa build

analysis -> publish -> verify for projects

```
fa build [-h] [--all] [--dry-run] [--preflight] [--json] [PROJECT ...]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `projects` | bare project name(s), see `fa list` |
| `--all` | every project, then consolidate the master manifest |
| `--dry-run` | show the steps without running them |
| `--preflight` | run `fa preflight` after publishing, before verify (verify then reports its findings) |
| `--json` | machine-readable result (child output is captured) |

## fa bundle

data bundles: check them against their contract, or list the contracts

```
fa bundle [-h] [--all] [--verbose] [--json] {check,contracts} [BUNDLE ...]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` |  One of: check, contracts. |
| `paths` | bundle folder(s) (default with check: every bundle under raw_data/) |
| `--all` | check every bundle under raw_data/ |
| `--verbose` | also list bundles and findings at info level |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |

## fa claims

numbers typed by hand into figure legends (they go stale when data changes)

```
fa claims [-h] [--list] [--write] [--check] [--json] [PROJECT ...]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `projects` | limit to these projects (default: all active) |
| `--list` | show each hand-typed number in context |
| `--write` | record the baseline (docs/baselines/hand_typed_numbers.csv) |
| `--check` | exit 1 if any figure has more than the baseline |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |

## fa diff-figure

what changed in a figure since a storyline snapshot or a saved record

```
fa diff-figure [-h] [--figure FIGURE] [--snapshot RNNN | --against RECORD] [--max-keys MAX_KEYS] [--json] PROJECT
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `project` |  |
| `--figure` | figure number (default 1) Default: `1`. |
| `--snapshot` | storyline snapshot (default: the latest holding the figure) |
| `--against` | a provenance record file to compare with |
| `--max-keys` | config keys listed (default 20) Default: `20`. |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |

## fa export

package a published figure as an RO-Crate (files, source data, provenance)

```
fa export [-h] [--figure FIGURE] [--out DIR] [--zip] [--include-inputs] [--json] PROJECT
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `project` |  |
| `--figure` | figure number (default 1) Default: `1`. |
| `--out` | crate folder (default outputs/exports/<project>_figure_NN) |
| `--zip` | also write <DIR>.zip |
| `--include-inputs` | copy the raw inputs into the crate (default: list them) |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |

## fa impact

which published figures used a given file or folder

```
fa impact [-h] [--json] path
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `path` | a file or folder, e.g. raw_data/<study>/<bundle>/inputs/data.csv |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |

## fa ingest

add a data bundle to a project: check it, write its full plots block, build

```
fa ingest [-h] --project PROJECT [--name NAME] [--no-build] [--dry-run] [--json] {bundle} BUNDLE
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `kind` |  One of: bundle. |
| `path` | bundle folder (inputs/ + metadata/metadata.yaml) |
| `--project` | the project whose config gets the plots block |
| `--name` | plots.<name> (default: the bundle folder name without _bundle) |
| `--no-build` | skip the confirming build |
| `--dry-run` | show the config change; write nothing |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |

## fa init

make a project repository here (or in PATH): folders, marker, rules, .gitignore

```
fa init [-h] [--dry-run] [--json] [path]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `path` | folder to set up (default: the working directory) |
| `--dry-run` | show the files; write nothing |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |

## fa lint

config keys the build never read, likely typos, and defaults used

```
fa lint [-h] [--defaults] [--verbose] [--max-keys MAX_KEYS] [--check] [--hardcoded] [--write] [--json] [PROJECT ...]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `projects` | limit to these projects (default: all active) |
| `--defaults` | list the keys that fell back to Python defaults |
| `--verbose` | list every unread key |
| `--max-keys` | unread keys listed per project (default 15) Default: `15`. |
| `--check` | exit 1 if a likely typo is found |
| `--hardcoded` | instead: literal style values (fontsize=7, ...) in renderers and analysis scripts |
| `--write` | --hardcoded: record the baseline |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |

## fa new

create a project (config, analysis script, figure spec, build-list entry) or a renderer (module with its SCHEMA, test, export)

```
fa new [-h] [--package PACKAGE] [--plot-type PLOT_TYPE] [--doc DOC] [--from RENDERER] [--domain DOMAIN] [--category {exploratory,paper}] [--raw-root RAW_ROOT] [--slug SLUG] [--dry-run] [--json] {project,renderer} name
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `kind` |  One of: project, renderer. |
| `name` | project name (lower-case letters, digits, -) or renderer name (a Python name: letters, digits, _) |
| `--package` | renderer: the package it goes in (default the core; a pack only for a field-specific shape) Default: `fig_atlas.renderers`. |
| `--plot-type` | renderer: bundles with this plot_type are drawn by it (fa ingest bundle) |
| `--doc` | renderer: one line on what the plot shows (module docstring) |
| `--from` | renderer: start from a copy of this existing renderer (`fa renderers`; the gallery shows each) instead of the placeholder scatter plot |
| `--domain` | namespace domain, e.g. lab (omit with --category for a flat sandbox project) |
| `--category` | namespace category One of: exploratory, paper. |
| `--raw-root` | input bundle folder (default raw_data/<name>) |
| `--slug` | figure 1 slug used in file names (default main) Default: `main`. |
| `--dry-run` | show the files and diffs; write nothing |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |

## fa omics

omics pack: list its modules, renderers, contracts and plot types

```
fa omics [-h] [--json] {list}
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` |  One of: list. |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |

## fa param

renderer parameters: scaffold | explain | sync

```
fa param [-h] [--apply] [--max-keys MAX_KEYS] [--include-computed] {scaffold,explain,sync} RENDERER|PROJECT [key]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` |  One of: scaffold, explain, sync. |
| `target` | a renderer (scaffold) or a project (explain, sync) |
| `key` | explain: dotted config key, e.g. plots.volcano.lfc_min |
| `--apply` | sync: write the keys (default: show them) |
| `--max-keys` | sync: skipped keys listed per reason Default: `8`. |
| `--include-computed` | sync: also write defaults the renderer computes (freezes today's value) |

## fa preflight

overlap, clipping and panel-intrusion checks (--projects ...)

Runs `fig_atlas.tools.preflight`; its own options: `fa preflight --help`.

## fa promote

promote an exploratory project to a paper figure (AGENTS.md 5.2)

```
fa promote [-h] --figure FIGURE --slug SLUG [--supp] [--no-build] [--dry-run] [--json] PROJECT
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `project` |  |
| `--figure` | figure number in the storyline |
| `--slug` | short name: <domain>-paper-main-fig<N>-<slug> |
| `--supp` | a supplementary figure (...-paper-supp-fig<N>-<slug>) |
| `--no-build` | skip the confirming build |
| `--dry-run` | show the moves and diffs; write nothing |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |
